native_mechanisms: Marks laid in fixed order on the flat stone before any heap is folded — the input's order is fixed by placement, never spoken/lost

Each heap races the musk deer's stride — uphill twist, downhill fold, doubling-back that eats its own trail — so no heap keeps the shape it entered with, the running shape carried forward into the next heap (plus the square-search: turning ninety degrees and folding corners into the centre until one changed mark smears across every square)
The owl seals the final folded shape to one fixed small size while every intermediate heap is burned — fixed-width, non-invertible output
core_technique: ChaCha-style ARX permutation (add/rotate/xor quarter-rounds, multiplication-free, plus extra xorshifts) over a 16x64-bit state absorbing 128-byte blocks by XOR with column rounds then diagonal rounds, block counter and length injected, finished by a halving tree-fold and xorshift-add finalizer to 64 bits (4x4-word small-state variant for len<128).
